author: Davidgo5867

english.text: My neighbours, the Wongs, who are multiracial from Fiji, seem intimidated by, and simultaneously jealous of, Latinate culture. Once a British colony, Fiji was never a "donkey" as was my homeland, the Philippines. I suspect that many Anglophones with less than a university education still squirm at long acrolectal Greco-Latin words in English, and they try to settle in their basilectal Anglo-Saxon speech. Tangentially, I much admire French-influenced paradises like Tahiti and Mayotte. Maybe, the Wongs should learn Dutch.

text: 我嘅鄰居，阿黃，佢哋係嚟自斐濟嘅多種族，佢哋似乎對拉丁文化感到恐懼，同時亦都妒忌，斐濟曾經係英國嘅殖民地，從來都唔係我嘅祖國菲律賓「驢」，我懷疑好多未受過大學教育嘅英語人士仍然會試圖用佢哋嘅英文語言，而佢哋嘅語言亦都係粗略嘅。 我好佩服大溪地同馬約特呢啲受法國影響嘅天堂。可能，阿黃應該學荷蘭文。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The Ogress knew the voice of the Queen and her children at once, and being furious at having been thus deceived, she gave orders (in a most horrible voice which made everybody tremble) that, next morning by break of day, they should bring into the middle of the great court a large tub filled with toads, vipers, snakes, and all sorts of serpents, in order to have the Queen and her children, the chief cook, his wife and maid, thrown into it, all of whom were to be brought thither with their hands tied behind them.

text: 妖精一下子就知道女王同佢啲仔女嘅聲音，對於被人呃咗好憤怒，佢就下令（用一種令所有人都震驚嘅最可怕嘅聲音），第二朝天亮，佢哋應該將一個大浴缸帶入大法庭嘅中間，浴缸入面裝滿咗蟾蜍、毒蛇、蛇同各種蛇將佢哋雙手綁喺後面帶去嗰度。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This is like that man who came before Rabba and said to him: "An official said to me, 'Go kill so-and-so and if you don't, I will kill you.'" He said to him, "He should kill you and you should not kill. What did you think, that your blood is redder? Perhaps that man's blood is redder."

jyutping: ni1 go3 zau6 hou2 ci5 go2 go3 jan4 lai4 dou3 laai1 baa1 min6 cin4，tung4 keoi5 gong2：「jau5 go3 gun1 jyun4 tung4 ngo5 gong2：『heoi3 saat3 go2 go3 go2 go3，jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 saat3，ngo5 wui6 saat3 nei5。』」keoi5 tung4 keoi5 gong2：「keoi5 jing1 goi1 saat3 nei5，ji4 nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 saat3。nei5 gok3 dak1 nei5 ge3 hyut3 hung4 di1 me1？ho2 nang4 go2 go3 jan4 ge3 hyut3 hung4 di1。」
text: 呢個就好似嗰個人嚟到拉巴面前，同佢講：「有個官員同我講：『去殺嗰個嗰個，如果你唔殺，我會殺你。』」佢同佢講：「佢應該殺你，而你唔應該殺。你覺得你嘅血紅啲咩？可能嗰個人嘅血紅啲。」
